Developer Platform

API Key Setup

Configure developer keys with VERITAS_DEV_API_KEY orVERITAS_ENTERPRISE_API_KEY on the backend. Use the key in theX-API-KEY header for authenticated endpoints.

YOUR_API_KEY

API Endpoints

POST/api/v1/verify-news

Submit a claim for full multi-agent verification. Returns truth score, status, and explainability breakdown.

{ "query": "Is Apple buying Disney?" }
POST/api/v1/stream-analysis

Request a WebSocket session token for real-time streaming analysis.

{ "query": "USA election integrity" }
GET/api/v1/alerts

Retrieve active global anomalies and misinformation spike alerts.

GET/api/v1/predictive-trends

Fetch early-warning trend predictions from the predictive intelligence engine.

POST/api/v1/feedback

Submit user feedback on a verification result to improve model accuracy.

{ "query": "...", "original_truth_score": 0.72, "user_flag": "incorrect" }
